The '''Kwazel Maw''' was a large predator native to the oceans of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Kwazel_Maw.png|thumb|left|200px|"Bogey", a Kwazel Maw in the swamps of Rodia.]]
They were clumsy swimmers and preferred to cling to undersea canyon walls, using their antennae to sense for prey that wandered too close. They could live up to 100 [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> Kwazel Maws were very similar in appearance to the [[Swamp slug/Legends|swamp slugs]]<ref name=":0" /> of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]<ref name="The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> save for the bio-luminescent markings along their bodies, a fin at the end of the tail, and their much greater size. Their skin was impervious to most laser blasts.<ref name="Bombad Jedi" />

==History==
{{Quote|I ''knew'' there was something in the water."<br />"Maybe its bark is worse than its bite."<br />"I hope you're right, for ''both'' our sakes!|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], upon encountering a Kwazel Maw|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance]]''</ref>}}
While on a [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|mission on Rodia]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] encountered a friendly Kwazel Maw, whom he affectionately named "[[Bogey (Kwazel Maw)/Legends|Bogey]]." This particular specimen seemed to be easily domesticated by Jar Jar, and also allowed [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to approach it. Bogey came in handy during the battle, allowing Jar Jar to stand on its back while it destroyed all the droids in its path, unharmed by their lasers due to its thick hide. It also toppled [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] shuttle into the sea, allowing the Viceroy to be captured by the Republic forces.<ref name="Bombad Jedi" />

Later that [[22 BBY/Legends|year]] the bounty hunter [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] was swallowed by a Kwazel Maw during a fight with [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. He was later regurgitated by the Kwazel Maw, where he was promptly captured by the waiting Fisto and his troops.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters Part II">[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part II)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part II)]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SwampSlug-McQuarrie.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Ralph McQuarrie's concept art, on which the Kwazel Maw is based.]]
The Kwazel Maw design is based on [[Ralph McQuarrie]]'s design for the swamp slug creatures of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].<ref name=":0">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode008.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Bombad Jedi}}</ref>
